physical.title: textile
physical.summary:
Cloth (probably a wrapper) formed of 8 strips of hand-spun white cotton, hand-sewn together along the selvedges. After assembling, the whole cloth has been stitch-tied with repeated blocks of three lines of chevrons, arranged regularly along each strip. The two outer strips have only a single block of chevrons; the five strips in the centre have two lines. The blocks are arranged to form bands across the cloth. The cloth has been dyed twice, once when stitched, and again after unstitching over the whole cloth. Along one end of the cloth is an extra pattern of two crosses on each strip.
This is a very close variant of Af1987,03.15.

physical.title: cloth
physical.summary: Cloth (woman’s wrapper), formed of twenty narrow strips of imported industrial cotton, hand-woven and hand-sewn together along the selvedges. The strips are of two types, arranged alternately. One has no pattern, and is of uniform pink thread in both warp and weft. The other is of uniform green thread in both warp and weft with a central warp band of yellow, and is embellished with a regularly repeating pattern created by using bundles of supplementary yellow thread. The cloth has not been hemmed.

physical.title: textile; blanket
physical.summary: Blanket (uldebe or munnyuure), composed of 9 narrow strips of hand-woven and hand-spun cotton of white and one shade of indigo. These are hand-sewn together along the selvedges. Each strip has the same weft pattern, which is formed either by alternating the white weft with blue indigo, or by the addition of a supplementary weft float forming patterns of squares or alternate horizontal and vertical lines. In the central area of the cloth nine pattern bands alternate with white bands. The warp ends form a long fringe.

physical.title: blanket
physical.summary:
Blanket "munyuure pinia." Blanket made of nine hand-woven cotton strips hand-sewn together selvedge to selvedge. Made of natural colour locally produced cotton threads, and locally produced cotton threads indigo dyed before weaving. 

The decoration is organised in blue and white bands with transverse continuous weft-faced arrangement. Nine bands have a white background and are decorated with blue trapezes and dots made in supplementary weft technique, forming in negative image a succession of white lozenges separated by white and blue lines. The other bands are blue and white plain weave bands some of which are decorated with either blue or white lines.

physical.title: blanket
physical.summary: Blanket, composed of nine narrow strips of hand-spun white and black cotton, hand-sewn together along the selvedges. The warp is entirely of white cotton; the weft is also white but has supplementary weft threads in black. These form three pattern bands of continuous threads across the cloth, plus five small patterns of discontinuous black threads placed randomly across the surface. The warp ends have been left to form a fringe.
